status: analytic candidate; role2 independent review pending

mass_projection.B_ratio: meff*S_cut/S, only when S is resolved and nonzero

elastic_recovery.cut_operator: V_cut_elastic=r_cut^T K u, including every elastic crossing path
elastic_recovery.Ritz_projection_alone: Phi^T e=0 does not imply r_cut^T e=0

minimum_procedure.action: Freeze same-model mass, signed mode, participation, constraints, cut and unit identities; verify CM sum equals complete mass projection.
Compute S, S_cut and cancellation indicator eta=abs(S)/sum(abs(m_i*phiCM_i)); quantify projection uncertainty; do not divide unresolved S.
Compute B, then check base-cut B=meff, nonzero scaling/sign invariance, conditional Cauchy bound; these are mass-projection checks and do not certify elasticity.
Check full Eigen residual or cut projected residual/native modal elastic cut; otherwise retain unverified elastic-output identity.
For a complete M-orthogonal positive-mass modal space, check sum(meff)=r^T M r and sum(B)=r_cut^T M r; finite modes retain remainder and near-degenerate spaces require common-basis matching.

zero_and_near_zero.S_near_zero: Compare abs(S) with projection error; tiny numerator/denominator is not evidence of a large true B
zero_and_near_zero.rounded_tables: Do not identify printed zero as an exact zero without precision information

actual_FNA.Gamma_zero: No direct uniform-input excitation; coupled modal coordinates can still be excited indirectly.
actual_FNA.actual_elastic_contribution: a*q, with actual compatible modal coordinate q; never divide actual q by a zero Gamma.
actual_FNA.other_outputs: Nonlinear link forces, damping output and displacement truncation remainders require their own recovery.
